title: Toward Secure LLM Agents: Threat Surfaces, Attacks, Defenses, and Evaluation
title_zh: 迈向安全的 LLM Agents：威胁面、攻击、防御与评估
abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are rapidly moving from conversational interfaces to software components that plan, invoke tools, maintain memory, and act on external environments. This transition changes the nature of security risk. In agentic settings, failures are no longer limited to unsafe text generation. Untrusted content may redirect control flow, misuse tool privileges, corrupt persistent state, leak sensitive information, or trigger harmful external actions. At the same time, research on LLM agent security is expanding quickly but remains fragmented across attack families, defense layers, application domains, and evaluation settings. This paper synthesizes 247 papers through a lifecycle-based, systems-oriented framework that models agent security around the interaction of information flow, delegated authority, and persistent state. We organize the literature around four questions: how LLM agent security should be modeled, which threat surfaces and attack families dominate, what defenses have been proposed and with what tradeoffs, and how security claims are evaluated. We find that prompt injection and tool-mediated control-flow hijacking still dominate the field, while persistent state corruption and multi-agent propagation are becoming central emerging concerns. We further find that current defenses provide useful building blocks but remain weakly compositional, and that existing benchmarks still underrepresent long-horizon, stateful, and deployment-sensitive risks. We argue that secure LLM agents require explicit trust boundaries, principled privilege control, provenance-aware state management, and evaluation practices aligned with realistic operational settings.
abstract_zh: 本文综述了 LLM agents 从对话接口演进为可规划、调用工具、维护记忆并作用于外部环境的软件组件后所带来的安全风险变化。与传统不安全文本生成不同，agentic 场景中的不可信内容可能重定向控制流、滥用工具权限、污染持久状态、泄露敏感信息，甚至触发有害外部行动。论文系统梳理了 247 篇相关研究，提出一个基于生命周期、面向系统的框架，从信息流、委托权限与持久状态的交互来建模 LLM agent 安全。作者围绕安全建模、主要威胁面与攻击家族、防御方法及其权衡、安全评估方式四个问题组织文献。综述发现，prompt injection 与工具介导的控制流劫持仍是主流威胁，而持久状态污染和多 agent 传播正成为新兴核心问题。现有防御虽提供了有用模块，但组合性不足；现有 benchmark 也未充分覆盖长时程、有状态和部署敏感风险。论文主张，安全的 LLM agents 需要显式信任边界、原则化权限控制、感知溯源的状态管理，以及贴近真实运行环境的评估实践。
key_points_zh: 论文综合 247 篇研究，提出以生命周期为主线的系统化框架，将 LLM agent 安全建模为信息流、委托权限与持久状态之间的交互问题。
当前最主要的攻击仍是 prompt injection 和 tool-mediated control-flow hijacking，即通过不可信输入或工具调用劫持 agent 的执行路径。
持久记忆污染、状态腐化和 multi-agent 传播被识别为快速上升的关键风险，尤其影响长时程任务和跨会话部署场景。
现有防御包括权限隔离、输入过滤、工具调用约束、审计与 provenance-aware state management 等，但整体组合性和系统级保证仍不足。
论文指出现有 benchmark 低估了真实部署中的长期、有状态和环境敏感风险，呼吁建立更贴近 operational settings 的安全评估体系。

llm_assessment.comment: A systems-oriented survey with strong lasting value for agent security governance, though its novelty is limited by being primarily synthetic rather than architectural.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一篇面向系统的智能体安全综述，对治理和安全有长期价值，但作为综述其原创架构贡献有限。
